features.name: Replication Pipeline Metadata Table Handling
features.description: Changed how replication metadata is passed between source and destination by using a database table instead of Data Factory activities input and output parameters, bypassing the 4 megabyte Data Factory limitation.

features.name: Unlimited Tables and Companies in Single Migration Run
features.description: Removed the limitation on the number of tables and companies that can be replicated in a single migration run by bypassing Data Factory parameter constraints, though Business Central still supports a maximum of 300 companies per environment.
caveats: Business Central still limited to 300 companies maximum per environment

features.name: Removed On-Premise Database Size Calculation from Replication Runs
features.description: Eliminated repeated database size calculation during replication runs, saving 15 to 45 minutes for large source databases and reducing timeout probability.

features.name: AL Number Sequences Support in Cloud Migration
features.description: Added support for AL number sequences data type in cloud migration, allowing numbering to continue in the Business Central tenant after migration instead of being reset.

features.name: Reduced Table-to-Table Copy Threshold
features.description: Lowered the threshold for large tables from 500 megabytes to 250 megabytes, meaning more tables now go through optimized table-to-table copy and replication status updates faster.

features.name: Index Optimization for Table Copy
features.description: Indexes are now disabled in the target table before copying data and rebuilt after replication, providing 8 to 22 percent performance benefit compared to copying with all indexes enabled.

features.name: Bulk Copy Size Reduction
features.description: Reduced bulk size for smaller tables in bulk copy process, resulting in higher numbers of smaller bulks that are easier for SQL Server to serialize and compress, achieving 60 to 80 percent performance improvement overall.
caveats: Timeouts may still occur on extremely weak or busy SQL servers

features.name: Diagnostic Runs Bulk Size Optimization
features.description: Made diagnostic runs respect the smaller bulk size configuration to prevent timeouts and out of memory exceptions that occurred when processing all data in a single large bulk.

features.name: Extended Change Tracking Retention for Delta Sync
features.description: Enforced longer change tracking retention period to keep change tracking versions valid longer, increasing the probability of fast delta synchronization for repeated replication runs.

features.name: Extended Delta Sync Eligibility
features.description: Expanded the conditions where delta synchronization is possible, including databases that first enable change tracking specifically for cloud migration, resulting in more frequent delta syncs and reduced overall migration time.

features.name: Azure SQL Direct Database Linking
features.description: When Azure SQL is used as source, the replication engine can now link source and destination Azure SQL databases directly without requiring serialized staging in Azure blob storage, eliminating serialization and deserialization steps.

features.name: SQL Variant Type Support for Azure SQL
features.description: Cloud migration now supports replication of SQL variant type fields when migrating from Azure SQL as source, which was not possible when using blob storage staging.

features.name: New Cloud Migration User Interface
features.description: A new user interface for cloud migration is being introduced to provide better overview of data migration status and problems, with the ability to switch between old and new UI for users who have customizations.
caveats: Both old and new UI are supported for backwards compatibility with existing customizations

features.name: Cloud migration failure drilling and visibility
features.description: The new UI displays failed tables with drill-down capability to show exactly which tables require attention, distinguishing between tables with actual failures and those where data was later successfully copied.
caveats: No warning system for tenant media table deltas yet

features.name: Unblock table action
features.description: An action that marks a failed table as passed and allows data to be migrated through configuration packages or other means, enabling partners to work around small table failures more efficiently.
caveats: Users must note company and table details before unblocking as they are removed from the list

features.name: Company and table status filtering
features.description: The new UI allows filtering to show which companies and tables have been moved, with a replicated filter to identify companies not yet migrated from on-premises.

features.name: Per-database table status verification
features.description: Users can view the status of all tables across different runs, including per-database tables like custom report layout and report selections, which are tenant media tables that should have more records after successful migration.
caveats: Warning system not yet in place for tenant media table issues
No accounting available for internal or obsolete marked tables

features.name: Table detail search and exclusion explanation
features.description: A page that provides details about specific tables, explaining why data was not moved, such as when a table is excluded due to replicate data property set to false or if the source table was empty.

features.name: Complete cloud migration action with sanity check
features.description: An action that performs a sanity check before allowing migration completion, preventing completion if failed tables exist and requiring users to pull data first.
caveats: Cannot complete if failed tables exist

features.name: Pause and abandon cloud migration actions
features.description: Two actions to manage ongoing migrations: pause for continuing later and abandon for deleting the environment entirely, with the only difference being telemetry sent to Microsoft.
caveats: Abandoned migrations can be reconfigured if regretted

features.name: Sanitize tables action
features.description: An expert-level action to run sanitization on specific tables in SaaS, which should have been done on-premises using invoke nav sanitize table, addressing data correctness before migration.
caveats: Can affect tenant performance
Requires specific company and table selection
Should be run outside business hours
Running on-premises is strongly recommended

features.name: Move customized fields to table extensions
features.description: A feature allowing automatic migration of customized fields from on-premises Microsoft tables to table extensions in SaaS, with automatic field mapping by name and type, and support for splitting data across multiple extensions.
caveats: Fields must be renamed to match on-premises names via AL or SQL scripts
Requires table mappings to be specified
Future namespaces may eliminate need for prefixes

features.name: Simplified UI for table mapping configuration
features.description: Dedicated UI page for adding table mappings that accepts table names in SQL format and automatically parses them, reducing errors compared to inline definition.
caveats: Must copy table definition from SQL with square brackets
Only works for AL tables
Table extensions must be uploaded before mapping

features.name: Bulk table mapping selection
features.description: Ability to select multiple table extensions at once when creating mappings, creating all required migration table mappings in a single operation instead of repeating the process individually.

features.name: Import and export of table mappings
features.description: Ability to save table mapping configurations to a JSON file for reuse across environments and replications.

features.name: Programmatic table mapping via event subscription
features.description: Partners can programmatically provide migration table mappings by subscribing to on insert default table mappings event from codeunit 4001, with mappings inserted when completing the setup wizard or resetting migrations.
caveats: Requires AL code development
Mappings are inserted during setup wizard or reset action

features.name: Cloud migration telemetry for partners
features.description: Partner telemetry events added for tracking and analyzing replication runs, including start, completion, success status, recovery completion, and disabling events.
caveats: Some replication runs may throw errors
Full list of events available in documentation

features.name: Power BI dashboards for cloud migration monitoring
features.description: Power BI dashboard template created by Microsoft PM showing cloud migration status across environments, with links to admin center and client, plus error and KPI tracking.
caveats: Requires Power BI
Queries available on BC Tech GitHub
Can access cloud migration log without accessing client

features.name: Email notifications for cloud migration events
features.description: Ability to subscribe to telemetry events for email notifications when replication run completes and when data operation completes or fails.
caveats: Requires prior setup configuration
Based on partner telemetry events

features.name: Stopping direct upgrade path from version 14
features.description: Microsoft is stopping the direct upgrade and cloud migration path from version 14 to latest versions after version 26, approximately two years from announcement. Currently version 14 can upgrade directly to latest on-premises or cloud migrate to version 26.
caveats: Timeline is approximately two years from announcement
Change affects both upgrade and cloud migration paths

features.name: Obsolete object removal to clean up schema
features.description: Plan to remove obsolete removed objects and tables accumulated over 7 years from version 12 through 14, which currently occupy approximately 10 percent of the database schema.
caveats: No objects have been deleted from version 12 to 14
Affects database size and schema complexity

features.name: Early obsolete object removal feature
features.description: Proposed feature to allow removal of obsolete removed objects and fields earlier than version 26 by deleting them from schema in version 25 and running upgrade, with the engine checking obsolete removed markers and dropping definitions.
caveats: Implementation not yet started
Requires object to be marked obsolete removed in prior version
Developer must delete from schema and clean up upgrade code
Microsoft follows schedule; partners do not

features.name: Version jump strategy (jump builds every 5 versions)
features.description: New versioning strategy where jump builds occur every 5 versions (version 25, 30, 35, etc.). Breaking SQL changes introduced at jump builds; intermediate versions can be skipped for cloud migration but on-premise must upgrade sequentially.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are planning to do these updates every five years so in every five versions We are planning to introduce a jumper build
caveats: Current thinking subject to feedback
Schedule may change

features.name: Company batch size specification for cloud migration
features.description: Feature to allow specifying company batch size when replicating data during cloud migration, enabling moves of 30, 40, 50 or more companies at once depending on setup limitations.

features.name: Include/exclude tables from cloud migration
features.description: New UI feature to override default Microsoft decisions about which tables are replicated. Users will be able to include or exclude tables without code, with the only requirement being the table is not marked as internal.
caveats: Tables marked as internal cannot be included/excluded

features.name: Delta sync for all-per database tables
features.description: Improvement to handle all-per database tables using delta sync instead of replacing the entire table, similar to how tenant media is delta synced.

features.name: Optional intelligent Cloud permission set assignment
features.description: Expert feature to disable automatic assignment of intelligent Cloud permission sets to all users when enabling cloud migration. Will be shipped as a small action to disable this default behavior.
caveats: Not disabled automatically at first, will be an expert action

features.name: Warning system for cloud migration
features.description: New warnings functionality in cloud migration UI to alert users when tenant media table is completely replaced or when table mappings are defined but no data was moved. Can be extended with additional warnings based on common patterns.

features.name: Cancel ongoing replication action
features.description: UI action to cancel ongoing cloud migration replication. Currently requires disabling the integration runtime on the machine, which does not always cancel the replication.
